Metadata.description: Start your Arabic and English Next.js site with RTL layout, Arabic fonts, number and date formatting, SEO and an MDX blog already set up.

Home.intro: A Next.js starter for websites in Arabic and English. Right-to-left layout, Arabic fonts, number and date formatting, SEO and a blog are set up, so you can go straight to building your pages.

mirror.title: Write it once. It flips by itself.
mirror.body: Below is the same component rendered twice, with no if (rtl) anywhere in it. It uses logical classes like ms-auto and text-start, plus rtl:-scale-x-100 on the arrows, so the browser mirrors it based on the page's dir. Arrows flip. Text, logos and numbers don't.

format.title: Numbers, dates and plurals, done properly
format.body: Arabic has six plural forms. Pick a number and watch the sentence change. All of it comes from next-intl and the browser's built-in Intl APIs, so there's nothing to write by hand.

routing.title: Locale routing
routing.body: Every URL starts with its language, /ar or /en. First-time visitors go to their browser's language.

rtl.title: Right-to-left layout
rtl.body: lang and dir are set on the html tag and every component uses logical classes, so Arabic pages mirror correctly.

fonts.title: Arabic typography
fonts.body: IBM Plex Sans Arabic for text and Reem Kufi for headlines. Both are self-hosted, so nothing is fetched from Google.

formatting.title: Formatting
formatting.body: Plurals, numbers, currency, and Gregorian and Hijri dates, using next-intl and the built-in Intl APIs.

switcher.title: Language switcher
switcher.body: Takes you to the same page in the other language, not back to the home page.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.body: Follows the system setting and remembers your choice, with no flash on load.

seo.title: SEO
seo.body: A title and description per language, canonical and hreflang links, a sitemap with both languages, and robots.txt.

og.title: Share images
og.body: Open Graph images are generated for every page, and Arabic titles render correctly. The default image renderer gets them wrong.

blog.title: MDX blog
blog.body: Write posts in Markdown with React components, one folder per language. No CMS needed.

types.title: Checked translations
types.body: A missing or misspelled key fails the type check, and npm run check:i18n compares both languages.

agents.title: AGENTS.md
agents.body: Tells AI coding assistants the RTL rules, so the code they write flips correctly too.

create.title: Create the project
create.body: Run this in your terminal. It copies the starter into a new folder.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.body: Set your site name, URL and links in src/config/site.ts.

content.title: Add your content
content.body: Translations live in messages/ar.json and messages/en.json. Blog posts go in src/content/blog.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.body: Push to GitHub, import the repo on Vercel, and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to your domain.
